SCI-REPO-Y9-NAR-2023-REACTIONS-MC12.answer: Formal balance requires2NaF+Br₂→2NaBr+F₂. Bromine cannot ordinarily displace fluoride;formal balancing is not evidence of a feasible spontaneous reaction.

SCI-REPO-Y9-NAR-2023-REACTIONS-MC14.answer: Photosynthesis is intended:oxygen is produced,not required as an input to its simplified net equation. Corrosion need not universally consume molecular oxygen,so the unqualified alternatives are scientifically too broad.
